description: What each raw Portal, FileMaker-silver and Sage relation is to the business, declared once: decision `type` (a business record type of its own), `extends` (rows that add facts to the record `extends` names: optional fields, statistics, schedules, comments), `links` (a copy of a record a curated type holds, reached through its link to `links_to`) or `skip` (a pure system or log table, `reason` starting `system:` or `log:`; its raw rows stay served and marked as before). `label` is the business name readers and Ask see; `about` leads the generated type's description; `display` (source columns) forms a record's name; `text` (source columns) is chunked for search under the row's own markings; `joins` are the declared foreign keys scripts/gen_raw_links.py writes as links (pairs from this relation's columns to the `to_binding` relation's, tier and why). Read by the generator (ontology/generator/build.py), scripts/gen_raw_links.py, ontology/raw_business.py and the record-text chunker. Every served raw relation no curated type shadows is listed (tests/ontology raw_business).
